aboutGame.title: What is Steal Anime Eggs?
paragraphs: Steal Anime Eggs is a Roblox anime egg-collecting simulator built around one addictive loop: earn income, buy eggs, hatch them for anime characters, place your best pulls on your base, and then steal eggs from every other player in the server while defending your own. It is free to play, and progress comes more from positioning and base discipline than from luck.

Every egg rolls through a rarity ladder that runs from Common and Uncommon up to Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythic or Secret. Rarer eggs hatch into stronger units and generate more passive income, but they also make your base a bigger target, so defense upgrades matter as much as your best pull. Codes, events, trading, and rebirth all feed back into the same loop, and our wiki breaks each system down with data tables and step-by-step walkthroughs.

faq.title: Steal Anime Eggs FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Steal Anime Eggs.

items.question: What is Steal Anime Eggs?
items.answer: Steal Anime Eggs is a free-to-play Roblox egg-collecting simulator. You earn income, buy and hatch anime-themed eggs, place your best pulls on your base, and steal eggs from other players while defending your own collection.

items.question: Is Steal Anime Eggs free to play?
items.answer: Yes. The full earn, buy, hatch, place, steal, and defend loop is playable without spending. Paid items mainly speed up progress rather than unlocking the core game.

items.question: What is the fastest way to progress in Steal Anime Eggs?
items.answer: Place eggs early so passive income starts immediately, save toward mid-tier eggs instead of re-rolling cheap ones, and take short, low-risk steal runs when the server is distracted.

items.question: How do I stop other players from stealing my eggs in Steal Anime Eggs?
items.answer: Invest in defensive upgrades, avoid leaving your base unattended for long stretches, and keep your most valuable eggs away from the entrance so raiders have to work for them.

items.question: Are there working Steal Anime Eggs codes?
items.answer: Codes rotate constantly, so any static list goes stale quickly. Check the in-game announcement feed and the developer's official channels, then test each code yourself before it expires.
